name: Marina Vendrell
description: A teenage-seeming girl whose actions enabled Valgavoth to take over the House.

description_citations.text: "Zimone Wola". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a flashback many years ago, a family arrives at an old house; the door swings open of its own accord to welcome them.
timeline.quote: the door swung open of its own accord, as if to welcome them home

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Marina notices the basement door standing ajar and senses that something patient waits below.
timeline.quote: That door stood ajar, revealing a thin slice of stairs descending into the darkness.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an impossible sunlit room where a teenage girl writes in a diary.
timeline.quote: Sunlight streamed through the two closed windows, bathing the teenage girl who sat on one of the larger couches

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: When the girl leaves, the room turns back into a rotting House room with blood in her footprints.
timeline.quote: Clouds immediately choked the sky outside, swallowing the sunlight

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes the girl repels the House and asks Tyvar to drop his camouflage.
timeline.quote: Whatever she is, she's repelling the House.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina sees the strangers and screams; they introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: Marina Vendrell.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina explains An Architectural Accounting, the book Zimone found, and admits to annotating it.
timeline.quote: That was started by the last person to live here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina denies the truth, chanting that they are not real, and the room erupts with nightmare beasts.
timeline.quote: You're not real, you're not here, you're not real, you're not here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The diary reveals that Marina met Valgavoth, a demon summoned and bound in the house by an earlier owner.
timeline.quote: His name is Valgavoth—Val—and he was summoned here and bound by one of the owners before us.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina chooses not to free Valgavoth because he is her only friend.
timeline.quote: Val is the only real friend I've made since we moved here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: After being bullied, Marina decides to invite her tormentors home and let Valgavoth make them pay.
timeline.quote: I'll invite them over tomorrow after school.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth takes the girls, pulling them into the walls.
timeline.quote: He took them. Hands reached out of the walls and grabbed them

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina realizes Valgavoth has become the house and is eating the world around him.
timeline.quote: I think Val is the house, somehow, after all this time

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Sixteen-year-old Marina and her parents buy and move into the House, where she is bullied at school.
timeline.quote: Marina was the target of frequent bullying.

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marina discovers the demon Valgavoth in the basement and befriends him; he teaches her demonology, necromancy and spirit-bending.
timeline.quote: she discovered the demon Valgavoth living in the basement

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After vicious bullying, Marina agrees to Valgavoth's offer and lures her four bullies to the basement, where he devours them.
timeline.quote: she watched, horrified, as the hungry entity came alive and devoured the bullies.

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Empowered, Valgavoth hunts; people around Marina die, the house warps and expands, and her parents vanish.
timeline.quote: But then, her parents vanished.

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marina researches and learns that previous owners bound the demon to the house, which she had unwittingly loosened.
timeline.quote: the entity in the basement was a demon

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marina threatens to burn down the house, and Valgavoth agrees to give her back the world as she remembered it, while the house keeps expanding until it swallows the plane as Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: the entirety of the plane was swallowed up in the walls of Duskmourn.

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around 4564 AR Zimone and Tyvar find Marina, who denies wrongdoing as the House shifts back to its nightmarish form; they retrieve her diary.
timeline.quote: Zimone and Tyvar managed to retrieve Marina's diary

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Tyvar meet Marina Vendrell and find her diary showing she enabled Valgavoth to take over the plane.
timeline.quote: Through her actions, Marina had enabled Valgavoth to grow and consume everything around him

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sixteen-year-old Marina Vendrell finds the demon in the cellar, and he befriends her to gain freedom.
timeline.quote: Seeing a path to his freedom, Valgavoth befriended her, helping her to learn demonology, necromancy, and spirit-bending.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marina lures her bullies into the basement and Valgavoth devours them; she realizes her friend is malevolent.
timeline.quote: She watched, horrified, as the hungry entity came alive and devoured the bullies.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Empowered, Valgavoth hunts; the house expands and Marina's parents vanish.
timeline.quote: But then, her parents vanished.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marina threatens to burn the house down and the demon agrees to restore the world as she remembered it, but the house keeps expanding until it swallows the plane.
timeline.quote: The demon grew in power until the entirety of the plane was swallowed up in the walls of Duskmourn.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Echoverse Winter hunts Valgavoth's master Marina Vendrell to rescue her from herself.
timeline.quote: Winter hunted Valgavoth's master, Marina Vendrell

citation.text: "Winter", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Tyvar find Marina Vendrell and her diary, learning she enabled Valgavoth to consume the House and take over the plane.
timeline.quote: Marina had enabled Valgavoth to grow and consume everything around him

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The House protects Marina and attacks her visitors.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

relations.note: Made a similar promise to Marina years ago.
relations.quote: I promised you what I promised my Marina, so many years ago

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

relations.quote: Winter now believes that defeating Marina Vendrell will reverse all the deaths caused by her control over Valgavoth.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
